feature_contract.goal: Continue the existing full-resolution DX11 game Draw/DrawIndexed GPU shared-desktop pipeline for both ARGB and XRGB real game Present backbuffers, with exact producer-device ownership and unmodified D3D9 input/FFB fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: D3D9Ex X8R8G8B8 destinations can receive a same-Present native full-size A8R8G8B8 shared GPU texture through StretchRect when the driver supports conversion.
Foreign D3D11 source owners, wrong backbuffer dimensions/formats and MSAA reject before CopyResource; driver conversion failure returns to original game-owned D3D9 Draw/Present/input/FFB.
All unchanged required GitHub Actions pass for precisely the validation-bearing material result SHA.

integration_path: Observed live game full-size native Draw/DrawIndexed produces an exact D3D11 BGRA render target
D3D11 shared GPU allocation imports on actual game D3D9Ex device; A8 and X8 destination selection and owner/extent/MSAA checks precede source CopyResource
Completed EVENT allows same-Present StretchRect; incompatible formats/owners or busy GPU retain original D3D9 desktop, gamepad, FFB and optional CPU fallback
batch_components: Live-game Present decision extended to X8 native GPU desktop output
Native shared D3D11 GPU source device ownership and real D3D9 backbuffer checks
Portable X8/A8 accepted and unsupported-format denied regression
